mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.2%, it signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity in financial markets, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative SPX returns, with the Rank IC falling below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for residential construction, which correlates with higher consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened uncertainty.
failure_condition: The joint movement of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative SPX returns, with the Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
